verdict.rationale: PayPal's Payouts API and REST APIs (OAuth token, transactions) let an agent send/pull payout data, and the agent toolkit exposes 'list_transaction' and 'get_merchant_insights' tools that could be used to fetch transaction/balance data programmatically. However, there is no direct evidence of a dedicated balance-transaction/reporting API (e.g., Balances or Transaction Search API) or documented reconciliation workflow matching bank deposits to underlying charges — the agent-tools inventory covers payments, invoices, disputes, subscriptions and generic 'list_transaction'/'get_merchant_insights' but not an explicit payout-to-charge reconciliation feature. missing for 10: explicit balance-transaction/reporting API docs, a documented reconciliation workflow or example matching payouts to charges, and independent/hands-on confirmation that an agent can perform this reconciliation end-to-end.
